_about: One rule for choosing a language from the browser's preferences, shared by the webapp (lib/i18n.js pickLanguage), the box's own pages (server-daemon i18n languageFor) and the website's first-visit redirect (apps/com localeRedirect.ts pickWebLocale). `accept` is an Accept-Language header; the webapp reads the same tags in q order as navigator.languages. `expect` is the language served, "en" for English. The rule: take the preferences in order; English (any region) stops the search; an exact tag wins; Traditional Chinese (zh-TW, zh-HK, zh-MO, zh-Hant) is never given Simplified; otherwise the same base language matches (pt-PT reads pt-BR, fr-CA reads fr).
